get.summary: Status, attempts and result of a long-running job
Jobs by status; status=dead is the dead-letter view
Latest audit events and whether the hash chain verifies

post.summary: (+) Load the synthetic mine: the block model's survey, exploration and blast-hole assays, a week of shifts (haul log, engine telemetry, plant hours); train and register the models against their baselines; issue the shift's baseline dispatch plan

(+) Run the shift forward under the active plan. The generator can be told about a low-grade zone or truck breakdowns (the demo's injection); the service sees only the haul log, telemetry, plant hours and assays, never the telling

Engine telemetry from an OEM feed or a probe: 10-minute summaries per truck. Each record is validated on its own (known truck, aligned window, not ahead of the clock or a day old, sensors in range, no duplicate per source); accepted records are scored by the anomaly detector like the fleet's own

get.summary: (+) The command centre: clock, fleet, plant by hour against the grade window, stockpiles, open alerts, the plan in force, the models

One bench of the block model as a grid: estimated grade, its 80% interval, the probability of high grade, the ore-control class and whether it is dug; the assays on the bench, the shovels' faces and blasts, and the ramp
(+) Every truck: status, where the active plan sends it, its last cycles and its engine against its own normal; open maintenance alerts with the anomaly's lead over the breakdown

post.summary: 202 + job: the dispatch MIP over the trucks that are up, from where they are: trucks and a target rate per shovel, where each shovel's high- and low-grade ore goes, stockpile reclaim, the plant's grade window and arsenic limit; returns a draft plan with its objective, optimality gap and solve time, beside the plan in force

202 + job: the hour-by-hour crusher blend for a plan: loader reclaim from each stockpile in whole loads and how much of each pit source to feed, inside the grade window and under the arsenic limit with the estimates' spread; beside the proportional blend on the same pit feed. The schedule becomes the plan's reclaim

202 + job: re-run the rest of the shift in the service's own simulation under each plan, with the cycle-time model's travel times, queues at the shovels and the crusher, block grades drawn from the estimator, and the same random draws for every plan; production, fuel, revenue and the economic objective with their spread and the paired difference

(+) Propose a draft plan for dispatch, with its twin run as evidence. Policy: the plan must carry a blend schedule and the twin must show it no worse than the plan in force. A proposal changes nothing until a shift supervisor who did not propose it approves
(+) A shift supervisor approves or rejects a proposed plan; the proposer cannot. On approval the plan is dispatched from the current minute and the plan it replaces is superseded

get.summary: (+) Dispatch plans: the one in force, drafts, proposals, superseded

Mill throughput and feed grade, hour by hour, under a plan (default: the one in force): the plan's pit feed and reclaim, the estimated hardness, the bin; the throughput model against the trailing 12-hour mean
